name: Zapier
description: Connects your apps so tasks happen on their own ("when this happens, do that").
coreFeatures: Triggers from apps (new form entry, new email, new payment…)
Actions in other apps (add a row, send a message…)
Multi-step workflows with filters and conditions
priceNote: Entry-tier prices; Zapier charges more as your monthly task count grows.
extraFeatures: AI steps that summarize or classify data
remakeNote: Integrations are the hard part. Consider building on n8n and only creating the custom steps you need.
